rateLimits.publishedNote: Vultr docs, FAQ and response headers state no rate limits (checked 2026-11-05).
rateLimits.policy: Gateway retries 429/5xx at most twice with backoff. Runner jobs are serialized (1 active job), so a comparison stays far below observed capacity.

modelParamsNote: Tested 2026-11-05: with thinking on, a research plan used the full 3000-token budget on reasoning and returned no answer; with enable_thinking=false the same request returned valid JSON in ~0.8 s using ~1/3 of the tokens.
notes: Filled after the capability gate passes (npm run smoke:inference -w @wallio/api). Prices are USD per 1M tokens from Vultr's current price sheet.
